q2_gaps: definite predicate nominal naming a uniquely-held role — "X is **the** capital / the president of Y"; the instruction set covers "X is a/an N" (Member) and the possessive of-phrase, but has no way to record that the role is unique (the parse is indistinguishable from "Georgetown is a capital of Guyana")
notes: Possession is the licensed route for a relational-noun of-genitive (the place-inside-a-place rule explicitly exempts relational nouns like "a tributary of the river"), and the parse correctly avoids coining a Capital head and avoids an unstated LocatedIn.
